question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
WITH new_unicorns AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.company_id,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as joined_year,
        ci.industry
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON cd.company_id = cf.company_id
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
),
top_industry AS (
    SELECT industry
    FROM new_unicorns
    GROUP BY industry
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ANY_VALUE(ti.industry) as industry,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(1) AS DOUBLE) / 3.0 as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM new_unicorns nu
JOIN top_industry ti ON nu.industry = ti.industry
